contract.task_clause:
A committee of middle school teachers is meeting to begin the process of finding a software program to improve students' drafting skills. Which of the following steps should the committee take first in the process?
Option A: Downloading a trial version of the most popular software for evaluation
Option B: Conducting a survey to determine the importance of drafting skills in the classroom
Option C: Defining the learning objectives they would like the software to meet
Option D: Deciding what type of user interface would be most appropriate
